back_translation: “As for you, son of man, take a sharp sword to use as a barber's razor, and shave your head and your beard; then take a set of scales and weigh out and divide the hair.

When the days of the siege are completed, burn a third of the hair with fire inside the city; take another third and strike it with the sword around the city; and scatter a third to the wind, for I will unsheathe a sword after them.
But take a small number of the strands and bind them in the folds of your garment.
Then take some of these again, throw them into the fire, and burn them; from there a fire will spread to the whole house of Israel.”
Thus says the Lord GOD: “This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the midst of the nations, with countries all around her.
But she has rebelled against My ordinances more than the nations, and against My statutes more than the countries around her; for they have rejected My ordinances and have not walked in My statutes.”

Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: “Because you have been more turbulent and rebellious than the nations around you, and have not walked in My statutes or kept My ordinances, and have not even acted according to the ordinances of the nations around you,”
therefore thus says the Lord GOD: “Behold, I Myself am against you, O Jerusalem, and I will execute judgments in your midst in the sight of the nations.
Because of all your abominations, I will do to you what I have never done before and will never do again.
Therefore fathers will eat their sons among you, and sons will eat their fathers; I will execute judgments on you and scatter all your remnant to every wind.

The Lord GOD says: As surely as I live, because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable idols and all your abominations, I Myself will also cut you down; My eye will not spare, and I will not have pity.

A third of you will die by plague and be consumed by famine in your midst; a third will fall by the sword around you; and a third I will scatter to every wind, and I will unsheathe a sword after them.

Then My anger will come to an end, and I will vent My wrath on them until I am appeased; and when I have spent My wrath on them, they will know that I am the LORD, and that I have spoken in My jealous zeal.
Moreover, I will make you a ruin and a reproach among the nations around you, in the sight of all who pass by.

You will be an object of scorn and taunting, a warning and a horror to the nations around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger, in wrath, and in furious rebukes. I am the LORD; I have spoken.
When I shoot the deadly arrows of famine against them, arrows that bring destruction, which I will send to destroy you, I will intensify the famine against you and cut off your supply of food.
I will send famine and wild beasts against you, and they will make you childless; plague and bloodshed will sweep through you, and I will bring a sword against you. I am the LORD; I have spoken.”
